messages.subject: Time recording — March entries outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Our records show unposted time for several matters for the week ending 27 March. Please complete and submit your time entries by 17:00 today so we can run the month-end bill production. If any matter should be marked non-chargeable, flag it to your supervising partner.

Thanks,
Accounts
